name: HandoffGlass
description: Bring grounded, human-controlled on-screen guidance to local AI workflows.
description_zh: 在本机屏幕上以可视化标注指导操作，并安全地将关键决定交还给用户。
description_en: Grounded local desktop guidance and human-controlled agent handoff.
examples_zh: 帮我在电脑屏幕上指出需要检查的权限
遇到二次验证时引导我完成操作，然后继续
examples_en: Show me where to inspect the requested permissions
Hand off MFA to me, then continue after independent verification
